text:
anya: Heads-up — I just noticed PII and a potential API key leaked into the eval artifacts from yesterday's model bring-up run :rotating_light:
chris: ugh. which runner and which artifact?
anya: eval-runner v2 on the nightly job. artifact s3://redwood-evals/nightly/1859xxx/run.tar.gz had a file 'samples.log' with prompts. snippet below:
```
PROMPT: Summarize user request
... user_email: alice@example.com ...
context: customer_token=sk_live_ABC12345xyz
```
leo: if that's true it's bad — we should treat runner logs/artifacts as restricted by default.
rachel: was the runner in debug mode? we had an earlier change that logs full request objects when LOG_LEVEL=debug.
anya: yep, the job had DEBUG=true in the docker env for quicker triage. mistakenly left on for the model bring-up.
chris: immediate actions: 1) rotate the exposed key(s) 2) revoke any sessions 3) remove the artifact and replace with redacted copy 4) add CI guard to prevent debug/release mismatch
leo: I'll rotate the key with secrets team. also a longer-term fix: make the runner redact any values matching known secret patterns before writing to disk. regex: sk_live_[A-Za-z0-9]{8,}
rachel: +1. also need PII redaction rules for emails, phone numbers, SSNs. can we reuse the privacy team regex set?
anya: yes, privacy team has lib at infra/privacy-redact; we should call that pre-write. also enforce artifact ACLs: only eval-service-role and an ops-sre role get read.
chris: for CI wiring: add a job post-build that scans produced artifacts for high-risk patterns. fail the job if anything matched. tests should run in both PR and nightly.
leo: plan for tests: create small harness that runs a tiny eval, collects artifacts, and asserts no patterns like sk_live_ or email regex appear. put under eval-runner CI (job name: artifact-scan).
ci-bot: artifact-scan job queued: build-1872-artifact-scan (ETA ~3m) :gear:
anya: config change we should land asap: default LOG_LEVEL=info in runner image and disable DEBUG via env override in orchestration templates. also set RUNNER_SANDBOX=true to ensure ephemeral mounts and no host-level logging of request content.
chris: i'll open a quick PR to flip the default and add a WARN in startup logs if DEBUG is enabled in prod clusters.
rachel: I'll change the dashboard to hide raw sample prompts by default; add a toggle for eng-ml admins with an audit log check.
leo: also adding an access-control policy for S3 prefixes: evals/* should deny GetObject for wide groups. only allow service roles and a short-lived presigned URL mechanism for downloads.
anya: follow-ups owners: chris -> PR for default log level and startup warn; leo -> rotate key + artifact ACLs + artifact-scan CI job; rachel -> dashboard toggle + audit; infra/privacy -> hook into runner pre-write (I can open the issue).
chris: ETA for PRs? I can do the default-LOG_LEVEL PR today, artifact-scan job by EOD.
leo: key rotation in next 10m, artifact removal now. CI job by tomorrow morning.
rachel: dashboard changes after the PR so we don't surface raw data; I'll schedule that for tomorrow afternoon.
anya: TL;DR: leaked PII+key from debug logs -> immediate revoke/remove/rotate -> add CI scanners + redaction pre-write + stricter artifact ACLs + default non-debug. thanks folks :lock: :eyes:
ci-bot: removed artifact s3://redwood-evals/nightly/1859xxx/run.tar.gz and created redacted copy run.redacted.tar.gz
ci-bot: open issues created: INFRA-482 redact-before-write, EVAL-297 artifact-scan-job
chris: closing loop: please post PR links here when ready and we'll follow up in the postmortem doc.
